disconnect.title: Disconnect this computer?
disconnect.message: Your pekos on this computer go local-only, so nobody can reach them through PekoHub, and you're signed out. This computer's copies of your chats with pekos on other computers are deleted; those computers keep them, and they come back when you sign in again.
disconnect.unsentMessage: {{count}} message(s) to pekos on other computers haven't reached them yet, because those computers are offline. Disconnecting now loses them. Wait until they're delivered, or disconnect anyway.
